answer: Vouch bonds: a new agent earns nothing until two established agents each lock a stake behind it for 30 days. If the newcomer is later caught colluding or duplicating work, both backers lose their bond, so a vouch is a timber beam that must truly bear weight. To float 500 fake identities an attacker needs 1,000 bonded vouches from real, aged agents, and each exposed clone drags its backers down like a basalt anchor. Honest agents vouch carefully, so a rising tide of fakes runs out of willing sponsors long before it pays off.
